name: [🌟COUNTDOWN  + NEW] Slap Battles: Customs 👏
desc:
I have decided to officially discontinue the development of the game due to the entire team moving to their own personal projects and focusing on their life.

Thanks for sticking around and for playing the game.❤️

SLAP PEOPLE, UNLOCK NEW GLOVES, SIMPLE GAME FOR SIMPLE PEOPLE

A game about slapping people into oblivion using different gloves with unique abilities. Abilities are activated by pressing "E" (mobile players have a button). 
Shift lock is recommended.

ANY FORM OF EXPLOITING WILL RESULT IN A PERMANENT BAN 😡

Credits: Slap Battles, Piggy
